title: Audit log API and export
goal: Expose the workspace audit log with filters and pagination, and asynchronous CSV/JSON exports, gated by the plan's `audit_log_days` and admin permissions.
scope_in: `GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/audit` (scope `audit:read`, admin+) with filters `actor`, `action`, `from`, `to`, CT-PAGE cursor pagination, newest first.

`POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/audit/exports` (A) creating an export job for a filter set and format `csv|json`; `GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/audit/exports/{exp}` returning status and a time-limited download URL.
Retention-aware reads: only events newer than `audit_log_days` days are visible; `audit_log_days = 0` means the feature is off.
Worker job `audit-export` that streams rows to object storage (gzip optional), with row cap and expiry.
Query layer over the `audit_events` table written by the emitter library (B036), with indexes for the filter set.
Audit event for the export request itself.
scope_out: The emitter library and the events' write path (B036).
Webhook or notification fan-out of audit events.
build_against: Seed `audit_events` with the factories from B010 (10 000 synthetic events, several actors/actions); object storage via the S3-compatible fake (MinIO container) from the testkit; no real R2.
interfaces: `GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/audit?actor=&action=&from=&to=&limit=&cursor=` -> `{data: AuditEvent[], next_cursor, has_more}`; `actor` is a `usr_`/`key_` id, `action` an exact dotted action name, `from`/`to` RFC 3339 UTC.

`type AuditEvent = {id: string /* aud_ */; at: string; actor: {type: 'user'|'api_key'|'system'; id: string|null}; action: string; target: {type: string; id: string|null}|null; outcome: 'success'|'denied'|'error'; request_id: string|null}` (provisional, see notes).

`POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/audit/exports` body `{format: 'csv'|'json', actor?, action?, from?, to?}` -> 202 `{id, status: 'pending'}`; `GET .../exports/{exp}` -> `{id, status: 'pending'|'running'|'ready'|'failed'|'expired', format, row_count?, download_url?, expires_at?}`.
acceptance: An admin of a workspace on a plan with `audit_log_days:90` gets events from the last 90 days only; an event at day 91 is not returned even if still stored.
With `audit_log_days:0` both list and export return 403 with an `entitlement_*` code; a `member` role returns 403 `forbidden`.
Filters combine with AND; `from > to` returns 422 with pointer `/from`; an unknown `action` returns an empty page, not an error.
Pagination over 10 000 events with `limit=200` returns all events exactly once in stable order while new events are inserted; cursors expire after 24 h.
List p95 <= 150 ms with 1 million events in the workspace and filter by `actor` (index used, verified by `EXPLAIN` in the test).
An export of 100 000 events completes in <= 60 s, the download URL expires after 900 s, and the file is deleted after 24 h; CSV cells beginning with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@` are prefixed with `'`.
Export creation with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the same export id; row count is capped at 1 000 000 and a larger result fails with `failed` and a safe reason.
The export request writes an audit event; reading the log writes none.
tests: unit: filter builder, cursor encoding bound to filters, CSV escaping and formula-injection guard.
integration: list/export against seeded Postgres and MinIO.
authz matrix across workspace roles and cross-workspace access.
performance: EXPLAIN assertions for the three filter combinations.
failure-path: export worker killed mid-stream -> job retried, partial object removed, single final object.
contract: list response matches CT-PAGE envelope; errors are problem+json.
guardrails: MUST scope every query by workspace id and apply the retention horizon in SQL, not in application filtering.
MUST NOT expose IP addresses, user agents, emails or free-text details; only ids, enums and action names (PII minimisation).
MUST stream exports (no full result in memory) and cap rows; pre-signed URLs MUST be single-purpose GET with <= 900 s TTL.
MUST NOT allow `api_key` principals with scope other than `audit:read`, and never users below admin.
MUST neutralise spreadsheet formula injection in CSV.
failure_modes: Object storage unavailable -> export job retries 3 times then `failed`; the list endpoint is unaffected.
Export requested for a huge range -> rejected early when a COUNT estimate exceeds the cap (422 with pointer `/from`).
Cursor from a different filter set -> 400 problem+json.
